summary.text: Marci Francisco is a Democratic member of the Kansas Senate representing District 2 (Douglas County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2005.
Marci Francisco is listed as the ranking minority member of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Marci Francisco is listed as a member of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, the Utilities Committee, the Assessment and Taxation Committee and the Federal and State Affairs Committee.
The Legislature lists Marci Francisco's occupation as Space (Facilities) Mgmt.
The page names Joe Bickford as Marci Francisco's spouse.
